name: @pryzm/headless
description: PRYZM 3 headless runtime — run the full PryzmRuntime in Node.js without a browser (no canvas, no WebGL). Phase F boolean #8 implementation. Created 2026-05-02.

scripts.//test:ci: ADDED 2026-08-11. This package previously had NO test:ci script, so `pnpm -r run test:ci` skipped it entirely — the third layer of nothing-checking behind the wholesale runtime-composer mock and the tsc noise. The suite is SLOW (~8 min cold: it transforms the real composition root's import graph instead of mocking it away). A slow gate that runs beats a fast one that does not exist.
